description: Video literary intent SSOT — mirror still IntentClassifier. Design decisions locked; extend via JSON.

designDecisions.soleAuthor: compileVideoPromptSpine — only five-section body author; dialect/vendor/sidecar are adapters
designDecisions.tripleWrite: dual-write generation.videoPrompt + generation.compiled.video (same hash); o_videoTrack.prompt is burn cache; hash mismatch forces recompile
designDecisions.durationPrecedence: required = max(authorDuration, lipMin, emotionFloor) → vendor snap → write shot.duration + Camera text + sidecar durationCapSec; never silent default 5s when author present
designDecisions.stillToVideoIntent: persist stillIntentClass on still compose; video hydrate inherits then classifyVideoIntent derives; no invent
designDecisions.literaryDetailInherit: still literaryDetailQuality atoms (contact/ground/surface/contactRoleXor/woundVisible/propReadable) already in VD must survive into spine Visual; never invent loci at video compile; XOR 互斥字面与浅痕可见度须原样继承；sparse VD → reverse SB hand_edit_vd/confirm_enhance before burn
designDecisions.viralSidecarOrder: bind inside spine BEFORE assertVideoPromptReady; never appendViral after QF/assert
designDecisions.llmRole: LLM must not author five-section body by default; only when context insufficient (no VD and no dialogue) AND seed stub; output must re-assert
designDecisions.thinShellRh: VP-THIN-SHELL → trigger video_prompt_stub (recompile this shot; forbid regen-only)
designDecisions.feWriteback: updateVideoPrompt rejects stub/thin shell or forces spine recompile; manualOverride.video for intentional hand edits

coverageBoundary: declared videoIntentClasses + safe degrade for unknown; never invent literary predicates

contactEventPolicy.note: 同源 still contactEventPolicy：react_silent 命中接触事件时 Motion 用 executableBeats，禁塌微表情呼吸

overlay.react_silent: when contactEvent → buildContactEventMotionBeats; never sole 微表情呼吸
